entities.name: UniProt P01574 IFNB1
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed human interferon beta (IFN-β), 187 aa; identity and coverage 100%.
Type I interferon cytokine binding IFNAR1/IFNAR2 and activating canonical JAK–STAT signaling to regulate interferon-responsive genes.
Participates in innate antiviral and broader immune responses; reported activities include antiproliferative and immunoregulatory effects.
Annotated as secreted and extracellular; N-terminal hydrophobic signal peptide is consistent with secretion.
Sequence-derived molecular mass is approximately 22.29 kDa; annotation does not establish activity of the unprocessed precursor.
